narrative.details:
Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.

You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText: By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, Rhett--and that's somethin' to be proud of.Keep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations -- and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.
narrative.requestItemsText: Aye, Rhett? What do ye have there?
